_comment_mode: 'direct' = you are on your institution's VPN/proxy (institutional IP). 'prefix' = library login-URL prefix (set proxy_prefix). 'ezproxy' = host-rewriting EZproxy (set proxy_host_suffix). Leave everything blank for open-access-only use.
_comment_prefix: Library login-URL prefix; the DOI landing URL is appended. Example shape: https://<your-library-proxy>/login?url=
_comment_ezproxy: Only for host-rewriting EZproxy. Suffix without leading dot, e.g. ezproxy.lib.your-university.edu
_comment_cookies: Netscape-format cookies.txt exported from your logged-in browser (prefix / ezproxy modes). Default: cookies.txt next to this file.
_comment_vpn_proxy: direct mode only: optional proxy used ONLY for the institutional step. Examples: socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080 or http://127.0.0.1:8080. Leave empty if you use a system-wide VPN.
_comment_download: Default output directory; override per call with -o.
_comment_email: Prefer the env var UNPAYWALL_EMAIL (any real address) over writing it here.
